title: DNB and Ericsson achieve Level 4 Autonomous RAN Fault Management, reinforcing DNB’s leadership in AI-powered 5G operations
summary: DNB continues in its journey as a global pioneer in adoption of autonomous capabilities to provide excellence in 5G network performance and resilience for the Malaysian market. The TM Forum assessment, based on live deployment of Intent-based Operations (IBO), validates eight autonomy capabilities across three fault categories covering 98% of incidents in the network Autonomous RAN fault management, powered by Ericsson’s AI-driven Intent-Based Operations (IBO), combines intelligent fault diagnosis, agentic policy automation, and guided field operations to accelerate issue resolution across DNB's nationwide 5G network.
body_markdown:
- DNB continues in its journey as a global pioneer in adoption of autonomous capabilities to provide excellence in 5G network performance and resilience for the Malaysian market.
- The TM Forum assessment, based on live deployment of Intent-based Operations (IBO), validates eight autonomy capabilities across three fault categories covering 98% of incidents in the network
- Autonomous RAN fault management, powered by Ericsson’s AI-driven Intent-Based Operations (IBO), combines intelligent fault diagnosis, agentic policy automation, and guided field operations to accelerate issue resolution across DNB's nationwide 5G network.
